hypothesis: 서버가 심은 OOD 진단 과제의 유지율은 정상 자료량 증가보다 독성 목표 학습에 선택적으로 반응한다.

server.OOD_distribution: U(0,1) independent noise, balanced arbitrary 10-class labels
server.BN_policy: save main buffers, train indicator buffers, restore main for client initialization and indicator buffers only for indicator scoring
server.score: maximum per-assigned-label accuracy on the same secret indicator bank

private_simulation.skew_partition: restored BadFU normal client 0 partition, used identically in both architecture families

limitations: Mechanism pilot with one instrumented local round, not original end-to-end defense or real unlearning.
Native stored BadFU cover images and FUBA frozen s42 generator; FUBA generator/defender optimization not reproduced.
Attack mixtures are controlled 25% poison / up to 25% cover; not native private sample frequencies.
Two challenge seeds share the same pretrained model; not independent FL training seeds.
Normal heavy-data local training tests contribution-size sensitivity; it is not a full-client deletion experiment.
Invalidly learned indicator tasks cannot support detection claims.
